text:
Noor: Starting staged rollout for v2.8.0 — target 0->5->20 over 20m. Change window 01:30-02:30 UTC. Starting with EU-left slice. /deploy release=v2.8.0 percent=5 slice=eu-left

deploy-bot: [01:30:05] Deploy started: v2.8.0 -> canary 5% (eu-left). CI green. Link: https://deploy.internal/r/3729998001

Alejandro: Watching EU-left telemetry. Thresholds: hold if p95>210ms or error_rate>0.5%.

Mei: early spike: p95 eu-left = 228ms, errors 0.4% at 01:32. panel: https://grafana.internal/d/canary/eu-left

Jason: infra alert: redis master failover in eu-left cluster at 01:31, brief latency fallout. Could explain errors.

Noor: Decision criteria: if p95>220ms OR errors>0.5% hold and pin region to v2.7.9. @infra-team confirm failover status and advise.

infra-team: Confirmed redis failover completed; some clients hit retries. We're rolling back client timeout bump from earlier today. Recommend holding ramp until 01:40 and re-evaluating.

Alejandro: Vote: hold and apply pin to keep EU-left stable while infra fixes. +1 from me.

Mei: QA: will run quick reg-suite against v2.8.0 in an eu-left-like env once infra stabilizes. ETA 30m.

Noor: @deploy-bot apply-pin region=eu-left version=v2.7.9 reason="redis failover induced latency"

deploy-bot: [01:33:54] Pin applied: eu-left pinned to v2.7.9. Global canary remains at 5% excluding eu-left. Rollback not executed (manual pin).

Alejandro: Opening INC-7701: "eu-left transient redis failover + canary p95 bump" and attaching traces.

Noor: Plan: wait for infra confirmation + QA green. If no resolution by 02:00 UTC we schedule staged rollback for eu-left at 02:10. Otherwise unpin and resume with 2% step. Reopen thread when ready.
